issues.detail: The Greek 'τελειουμαι' (teleioumai) is a passive/middle voice verb meaning 'I am being completed' or 'I will be finished/completed'. The Vietnamese translation 'ta sẽ được trọn vẹn' (I will be complete/perfect) changes the meaning from the completion of the *action* (the exorcisms and healings) to the completion of the *subject* (the person). The Greek implies the work is finished by the third day, not that the speaker becomes 'complete'.
